address: via Feniletto 2, località Vallese, Oppeano, 37050, Italy
bio: Within the Feniletto Nature Oasis, the facility unfolds among a wooded garden, a farmyard dedicated to farm animals, stables with horses, an organic vegetable garden and an orchard. The restaurant enjoys a cosy and warm atmosphere, almost as if it were the living room at home, amid wooden furnishings and soft lighting. Look for a very rare object with your eyes that you can hardly admire elsewhere: the tooth of a Tyrannosaurus rex, a true work of art handed down to us by time! Protagonist of the new course is, as of early 2024, the talented chef Francesco Sodano, who offers three tasting courses: Ricomincio da tre, inspired by Campania (his region of origin, as well as that of Massimo Troisi from whom he borrowed the name) and the most successful dishes of his personal journey; The Doors, ...
